🌧 A storm system originating from the Pacific is hitting California this Thursday, November 19, with heavy rain, strong winds, and snow in mountainous areas, keeping the National Weather Service (NWS) on alert for flash floods and mudflows in fire-affected areas, especially in Los Angeles. 🚨 In San Francisco, the rainfall set a daily record for November 18 with 6.7 centimeters — surpassing the 1918 mark — flooding roads with more than 30 centimeters of water and requiring the rescue of trapped drivers, while landslides were reported in Big Sur and fallen trees in Santa Barbara and San Luis Obispo. 🌊 According to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), the storm is occurring under a strong El Niño episode that could extend until March 2027.

China Imposes Export Restrictions on Drone Components Used by Russia as Putin Visits Beijing Beijing has introduced export restrictions on engines and other components used by Russia to manufacture Shahed drones, The Moscow Times reports. The new rules, adopted a month ago, came into effect on the day Russian leader Vladimir Putin arrived in China for the APEC summit and meetings with Donald Trump and Xi Jinping. The restrictions cover jet engines for drones, high-power electric motors, radio modules, autopilot systems, and drone manufacturing technologies. Specifically, they apply to jet engines with a thrust of at least 400 newtons and electric motors with an output exceeding 16 kW. Such components could be used to produce jet-powered versions of Shahed drones at Russia’s Alabuga facility. The measures do not amount to a complete export ban. Instead, Chinese exporters must obtain special licenses to supply the listed components abroad. The rules apply to exports to all countries, not just Russia. However, Ukraine has identified several loopholes in the restrictions. Vladyslav Vlasiuk, the Presidential Commissioner for Sanctions Policy, said that several critical components used in Russian drones remain outside the scope of the controls: - CRPA anti-jamming antennas; - Navigation modules; - HARXON antennas; - Stabilized-gimbal cameras; - Servo actuators.
